company_name: Xuzhou B&C Chemical Technology Co., Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: High — Xuzhou B&C Chemical Technology Co., Ltd specializes in the development and manufacturing of photoresists and related materials crucial for semiconductor fabrication.
summary: Xuzhou B&C Chemical Technology Co., Ltd is a national high-tech enterprise focused on R&D and manufacturing of medium- to high-end photoresists and their raw materials. The company has established a comprehensive supply chain for photoresist materials, serving over 70 domestic chip manufacturers with a wide range of products tailored for advanced lithography processes.
capabilities: Development of ArF/KrF monomers and photoresists
Production of G-line and I-line photoresists
Customization of R&D efforts for lithography materials

regional_presence.China: The company has R&D and production bases in Shanghai and Jiangsu, and serves a significant number of domestic chip manufacturers.
